_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry -- batch 'stim_source' (D25, Tier-2 frontend cluster)
(docs/SIMULATOR.md SS12.3/12.4; full-coverage program;
work-list docs/SIMULATOR.md D25).
Run via tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: frontend/stim_source.py -- the circuit-SOURCE adapters the simulator frontend uses to keep
the ORIGIN of a compiled Stim circuit explicit: keyed in-repo CircuitIR, an already-compiled pair,
and imported/on-disk Stim circuits all feed the same CompiledCircuit artifact path. It is NOT a
noise/mechanism model and NOT evaluator truth: CompiledCircuit carries the ideal/noisy Stim pair +
a validated public-artifact metadata record + a separate evaluator-only source-projection audit
field. It imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb (dataclasses + hashlib + pathlib + the sibling
frontend.stim_io/metadata_guard/noise_spec/record_schema helpers), so EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE
and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 -- out_of_scope is therefore {} (the AST reconcile refuses any
gpu_bound claim on a torch-less module; torch appears in sys.modules only via an UNRELATED transitive
import, never in stim_source.py's OWN import list -> ZERO out_of_scope).
SIX public units (AST reconcile _public_units_in_module: top-level public defs + every public method
of a top-level class INCLUDING the load-bearing __post_init__ dunder). The private module helper
_sha256_file (leading `_`) is NOT a public unit -- the coverage audit does not score it -- but it IS
mutated by mutmut and is exercised end-to-end through StimCircuitSource.from_file (its chunked read +
hexdigest are pinned against an INDEPENDENT hashlib recompute):
* CompiledCircuit.__post_init__ -- validates + normalizes the compiled-circuit record: refuses a
non-'stim' backend / non-'stim_pauli' representability (require_frontend_representability),
require_stim_circuit on BOTH the ideal and noisy artifacts (label-tagged), require_matching_schemas,
the record_schema 4-count reconcile (a 4-way `or` of `!=`), validate_public_metadata on metadata +
(conditionally) noise_manifest, str-coerces source_type/backend/representability, validate_evaluator
_sidecars, and the evaluator-only source_projection_audit visibility guard (the isolation-contract
'truth-laundering' boundary).
* CircuitSource.compile -- a typing.Protocol ABSTRACT STUB (runtime_checkable); its body is a lone
docstring. It is a public method of a top-level class, so the AST reconcile counts it as a unit; its
def line is covered by IMPORT (the method is never called -- Protocols are not instantiated). It is
still registered (out_of_scope cannot hold a torch-less unit).
* CircuitIRSource.compile -- projects the keyed CircuitIR through apply_stim_pauli_noise, emits the
ideal + noisy stim circuits, threads noise_manifest (from the stored noise_projection metadata, else
the noise's own manifest) + the evaluator-only source_projection_audit, and builds the CompiledCircuit.
* CompiledCircuitSource.compile -- identity wrapper for an already-compiled pair; refuses NON-TRIVIAL
new noise (`noise is not None and not noise.is_trivial`), else returns the stored CompiledCircuit.
* StimCircuitSource.from_file -- classmethod: reads the ideal (and optional noisy) .stim file(s) via
stim_io.load_stim_circuit, records path + _sha256_file hash into metadata, sets noisy_is_ideal when
no noisy path is given.
* StimCircuitSource.compile -- refuses non-trivial noise (NotImplementedError -- raw Stim placement is
location-ambiguous in this slice), synthesizes the noise_manifest (noise manifest, else the
pre-noised-source stub when a noisy circuit is present), and reuses ideal as noisy when noisy is None.
L2 DISCIPLINE (100% coverage != discrimination).
* CompiledCircuit.__post_init__: the 4-way count reconcile is killed OPERAND-BY-OPERAND -- FOUR
separate tests each pass a record_schema (dataclasses.replace of the actual from_stim schema) that
differs in EXACTLY ONE of num_qubits/num_measurements/num_detectors/num_observables, with the EXACT
reconstructed raise message (record_schema=... actual=...) via assert_raises_exact -> each `!=`->`==`
and the `or`->`and` variants flip a valid input into no-raise / a spurious raise and die; a clean
record_schema=None construction exercises the False arc + the `record_schema or actual` None arm
(a `or`->`and` mutant makes schema=None -> AttributeError -> killed), and a matching record_schema
exercises the truthy arm + the record_schema setattr (asserted is-not-None). require_stim_circuit is
tripped for BOTH the 'ideal_circuit' and 'noisy_circuit' labels (a non-stim ideal / non-stim noisy)
with the EXACT '<label> must be stim.Circuit, got <class \'str\'>' message -> the two label string
literals die. metadata + noise_manifest reserved-key rejections are pinned EXACT with their
'CompiledCircuit.metadata' / 'CompiledCircuit.noise_manifest' labels (kills the label wraps + proves
validate_public_metadata is load-bearing); the noise_manifest ternary is killed both ways (None-arm
default keeps cc.noise_manifest None; a valid non-None dict is stored as a COPY, is-not the input).
source_type is passed as an int and pinned == '123' (kills the 'source_type' setattr-key wrap +
proves the str() coercion); metadata/evaluator_sidecars stored values are asserted to be COPIES /
a tuple (kills those setattr-key wraps). The source_projection_audit branch is killed: an invalid
visibility raises the EXACT 'source_projection_audit must be visibility=...' message (kills the
`!=`->`==`, the 'visibility'/'evaluator_only' wraps -- a wrapped key/value makes .get(...) != ...
True and raises even on a VALID audit), a valid audit is stored as a COPY (is-not the input; kills
the `is not None`->`is None` mutant which would either skip the copy or dict(None)->TypeError).
* CircuitIRSource.compile: source_type=='circuit_ir' pinned; metadata is the CLEAN original circuit's
dict (a copy, is-not); noise=None keeps noise_manifest None (the `if noise is not None` False arc); a
NON-TRIVIAL TargetedStimNoiseSpec makes the STORED noise_projection carry 'matched_counts' that the
noise's own to_manifest() lacks -> pins the 'noise_projection' .get key (a key wrap falls back to the
bare manifest -> no matched_counts -> killed); a TRIVIAL StimPauliNoiseSpec exercises the .get DEFAULT
fallback arm. A source-projection spec drives the ISOLATION-CONTRACT faithfulness pin: public
cc.metadata stays clean (no 'source_timeline') while cc.source_projection_audit rides evaluator-only
(visibility=='evaluator_only', carries 'source_timeline'), and cc.noise_manifest declares the reduced
projection + matched_counts.
* CompiledCircuitSource.compile: identity return pinned (`is`); noise=None + trivial both return; a
NON-TRIVIAL noise raises the EXACT 'cannot apply new noise to an already compiled circuit pair' (the
`and` is exercised in all three arcs -> an `and`->`or` / `is not`->`is` mutant AttributeErrors or
flips the raise -> killed).
* StimCircuitSource.from_file: the meta dict keys (ideal_path/ideal_sha256/noisy_path/noisy_sha256/
noisy_is_ideal) are pinned by EXACT-dict comparison (kills every key wrap) with the sha256 pinned
against an INDEPENDENT hashlib recompute of the file bytes (kills the _sha256_file 'rb' mode wrap ->
open() error, and the `*`->`/` chunk-arithmetic -> f.read(float) TypeError); the `if noisy_path is
not None` True/False arcs (noisy path present vs noisy_is_ideal=True) and the `metadata or {}` arms
(None vs a truthy dict whose keys survive) are both exercised.
* StimCircuitSource.compile: NON-TRIVIAL noise raises the EXACT NotImplementedError; the pre-noised
stub manifest {'type':'pre_noised_stim_source','source_type':'stim_circuit','placement':'external'}
is pinned by EXACT-dict comparison for the (noisy present, noise None) arc; a TRIVIAL noise routes
the noise's own manifest through instead (the `noise_manifest is None` second-operand False arc);
the no-noisy arc reuses ideal as noisy (the noisy-circuit ternary else) and yields noise_manifest
None; source_type=='stim_circuit' and dict(metadata or {}) copy pinned.
REACHABILITY (the D13/D18/D19 default-arg / guard-route lesson -- PROBED through the PUBLIC entry points,
never asserted). Every raising guard is tripped through a real construction/call route with the EXACT
message: the record_schema reconcile (4 field routes), require_stim_circuit (ideal + noisy label routes),
the metadata + noise_manifest reserved-key guards (label routes), the source_projection_audit visibility
guard (invalid-visibility route + a valid-visibility no-raise route), CompiledCircuitSource's
already-compiled refusal, and StimCircuitSource.compile's location-ambiguous refusal. Every branch of
each unit's OWN AST body is REACHABLE through a public entry (constructor / classmethod / compile),
checked not assumed.
L2 STRUCTURAL CAP (MEASURED 2026-07-08 -- a STOP-and-report finding, reviewer decides bar-override).
mutmut 3.6.0 mutates ONLY module-level (top-level) functions -- it emits ZERO mutants for methods inside a
class (verified: mutate_file_contents yields only x__sha256_file__* here; operation.py/D24 likewise only
mutates its 3 top-level funcs, never OperationSpec/OperationSet methods -- the D13 CODEBOOK note is
general). ALL SIX public units of stim_source.py are class methods (5 compile/from_file + __post_init__),
so they carry NO L2 mutants; the ENTIRE mutation surface is the ONE top-level private helper _sha256_file
(16 mutants). Their correctness is pinned instead by 100% L0 stmt+branch + the exact-message / exact-dict
asserts + the L1 Hypothesis properties above. Of the 16 _sha256_file mutants ALL 11 KILLABLE ARE KILLED
(type-error / wrong-hash: mutmut_1..6,8..10,12,16 -> AttributeError/TypeError/ValueError/empty-iter wrong
hash, each caught by the exact-sha256-vs-independent-hashlib pin). The 5 residuals are ALL structurally
unkillable by any PASSING test (measured, not guessed): (a) THREE GENUINE HASH-INVARIANT EQUIVALENTS --
mutmut_11 (f.read(None) reads the whole file), mutmut_13 (chunk 1025*1024), mutmut_14 (chunk 1024*1025);
chunked sha256 is chunk-size-invariant so each streams a BYTE-IDENTICAL digest (empirically == orig); and
(b) TWO INFINITE-LOOP TIMEOUT SURVIVORS -- mutmut_7 (iter sentinel b''->None) and mutmut_15 (sentinel
b''->b'XXXX'); f.read() returns b'' at EOF which never equals the mutated sentinel, so iter never
terminates -> the read hangs -> a passing test CANNOT catch it (only a timeout can, which the harness
counts as survived). kill_rate is therefore STRUCTURALLY CAPPED at 11/16=0.6875 (= 11/11=100% of the
KILLABLE surface). This is NOT a weak-test gap: the load-bearing adapter logic simply lies outside mutmut
3.6's reach. src is NOT edited to game the metric; the honest resolution is a reviewed harness.
mutation_gate bar-override (cf. D24), left to the reviewer per the STOP-and-report discipline.
NO exemptions + NO out_of_scope: every SCORED unit is CPU-pure and every branch of its OWN AST body is
REACHABLE through a public entry point.
